race.comment: KOKO (9) is an eight-start maiden who has been in the money at her last couple of runs, the latest when second over 1000m at Moe. Draws beautifully here and this might be her best chance yet. HAUTE (8) hasn't trialled like a superstar but hails from a stable renowned for getting them to win on debut and it's worth noting there was good support as soon as markets went up. SERVENIA (10) was never in contention last time over 1100m at Sale when she finished 11th, beaten 4.5 lengths, but the run prior was good. Finds a suitable assignment this time and is a great chance to break through. FLAMINGO FLYER (3) finished fourth over 1000m at Pakenham Synthetic when resuming last start, beaten only 1.75 lengths. Fitter so anticipating a better run this time. TOROKAWA (11) wasn't disgraced in two runs in the first prep and has trialled like she's improved between campaigns.
